title: [DEMO] Water Quality and PFAS Monitoring
description: Supports state government projects for water quality monitoring, PFAS assessment, groundwater protection, and watershed planning.
eligibility_text: State governments may apply. Fictional test eligibility.

title: [DEMO] Community Recycling Equipment
description: Funds recycling equipment, materials recovery, and solid waste reduction projects for local governments.
eligibility_text: Only local governments may apply; state agencies are not eligible. Fictional test eligibility.

title: [DEMO] Flood Resilience Planning
description: Supports flood mitigation, disaster recovery planning, and nature-based solutions that improve community resilience to extreme weather.

title: [DEMO] Hospital Workforce Training
description: Supports nurse recruitment, clinical staff training, and hospital workforce retention.
eligibility_text: State governments may apply. Fictional test eligibility.
